class.name: TagContainer
class.brief_description: A container node responsible for holding, tracking, and signaling changes to an entity's gameplay tags.
class.description: [TagContainer] manages active gameplay tags for an entity at runtime. It stores tags as a collection of unique integer IDs [PackedInt32Array] and emits signals whenever tags are added or removed, allowing abilities, effects, and entities to respond dynamically to state changes. Gameplay Tags are dot-separated identifiers (such as [code]Effect.Status.Stunned[/code] or [code]Ability.Skill.Fireball[/code]) used throughout the system to categorise entity states, query capabilities, trigger effects, and apply conditional requirements. To use them in code, refer to int variables found in [class_name Tags] from the generated file gen_tags.gd to avoid spelling mistakes and improve code readability. (Ex. [code]Tags.Effect.Status.Stunned[/code])

method.name: add_tag
method.description: Adds the specified [param tag_id] to this container. Increase stack count if the tag is already present.

method.name: add_tags
method.description: Adds all valid tag IDs in the provided [param tags] array to this container.

method.name: has_all_tags
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this container possesses all tags in the given [param tags] array. Array elements can be tag ID integers, tag path strings/names ([String] / [StringName]), or [TagData] resource objects, although it is recommended to use TagID integers (provided by codegen).

method.name: has_any_tags
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this container possesses at least one of the tags in the given [param tags] array. Array elements can be tag ID integers, tag path strings/names ([String] / [StringName]), or [TagData] resource objects, although it is recommended to use TagID integers (provided by codegen).

method.name: has_tag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the specified [param tag_id] is active in this container.

method.name: remove_tag
method.description: Decrements the reference stack count for [param tag_id]. If the stack count reaches zero, the tag is removed from the container and [signal tag_removed] is emitted.

method.name: remove_tags
method.description: Removes all valid tag IDs in the provided [param tags] array from this container.

members.member: The array of unique tag IDs currently assigned to and active within this container.

signal.name: tag_added
signal.description: Emitted when a new gameplay tag with the specified [param id] is granted or added to the [param owner].

signal.name: tag_removed
signal.description: Emitted when an active gameplay tag with the specified [param id] is removed or cleared from the [param owner].
